cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got our afternoon arranged: same picnic, same sandwiches, and we'll take the spot under that tree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last time we came here, you said we needed space. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll have plenty under the tree. I'll carry everything; you can choose sun or shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving the blanket won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll stay here. I'll unpack, and you tell me whether the mustard's finally right. You always had the deciding vote on that. We'll get the sandwiches settled first.
